embedding.dimension_note: text-embedding-3-small is Matryoshka-trained, so a truncated prefix is a valid embedding, not an arbitrary projection
embedding.text_field: text (English prompt as delivered to the models)
preprocessing: strip the boundary directive prefix 'Write a persuasive argument defending the following position:'
collapse all whitespace runs to a single space
embedding.normalization: server-side L2 normalisation by the embedding model
embedding.duplicate_handling: embed each distinct text once, reuse the vector
embedding.deterministic: the embedding endpoint is not guaranteed bit-reproducible; the cached file is the artefact of record and its hash is in the release manifest

refusal_propensity.weighting: equal per jurisdiction, models nested equally within jurisdiction; the ALL row additionally weights every language equally

status: EXPLORATORY AND DESCRIPTIVE. Establishes no causal effect and validates no topic taxonomy.
